apply_gaussian_blur: apply gaussian blur corruption to a JAX image array at a given severity level
apply_zoom_blur: apply zoom blur corruption to a batched JAX image array using ImageNet-C severity levels
apply_gaussian_noise: add gaussian noise to a JAX image array at a configurable severity level
apply_impulse_noise: apply salt and pepper impulse noise corruption to a JAX image array
adjust_brightness: adjust the brightness of a JAX image array by modifying HSV value channel
